news.title: An undisclosed buyer completed the acquisition of 58.02% stake in Ayatti Innovative Private Limited from Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited (NSEI:PARAS) for INR 69.9 million.
news.body:
An undisclosed buyer agreed to acquire 58.02% stake in Ayatti Innovative Private Limited from Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited (NSEI:PARAS) on March 28, 2025. As part of acquisition, 15,20,000 shares will be sold.

As of May 31, 2024, Ayatti Innovative Private Limited reported net worth of INR 25.54 million.

 The expected completion of the transaction is December 31, 2025. As of December 26, 2025, it is informed that the due diligence exercise by the prospective buyers is presently underway and is expected to take additional time. So, the completion of deal is postponed to March 31, 2026.

news.title: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited (NSEI:PARAS) completed the acquisition of 49% stake in Himanshi Thermal Solutions Private Limited from Defspace Technologies Private Limited.
news.body:
Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited (NSEI:PARAS) agreed to acquire 49% stake in Himanshi Thermal Solutions Private Limited from Defspace Technologies Private Limited for INR 0.05 million on February 17, 2026. Pursuant to the acquisition, Himanshi Thermal Solutions Private Limited shall become an Associate Company of Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Himanshi Thermal Solutions Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 0.

The transaction has been approved by the board of directors of Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited. The expected completion of the transaction is March 31, 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.26 (vs ₹1.87 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.26 (up from ₹1.87 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.06b (up 24% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹182.1m (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 17% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 41% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Aerospace & Defense industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 29% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 32% per year.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.56 (vs ₹1.78 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.56 (up from ₹1.78 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.08b (up 24% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹206.4m (up 49% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 19% (up from 16% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 38% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Aerospace & Defense industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 26% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 35% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited Approves Dividend
news.body: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited announced that the Shareholders of the Company has approved dividend of INR 0.50/- per equity share at the Annual General Meeting held on August 21, 2025.
